Act7-1a#1.zh: 董超、薛霸和那伙强人已被打退。林教头无恙，众人仍暗中护送他去沧州。
Act7-1a#1.t: Dong Chao, Xue Ba and the bandits have been driven off. Instructor Lin is unharmed, and the group keeps escorting him to Cangzhou in secret.

Act7-1a#4.zh: 你不是陆虞候吗？怎么会在这里？
Act7-1a#4.t: Aren't you Captain Lu? What are you doing here?

Act7-1a#5.zh: 林教头受的委屈，已经传遍整个东京，连皇帝都惊动了！现在高俅已经被解除官职，正等待林教头回去跟高俅对质呢！我是特地来通知林教头回去，以免林教头遇上了什么意外。
Act7-1a#5.t: The injustice you suffered is the talk of Kaifeng; even the Emperor has heard of it! Gao Qiu has been stripped of his post and is waiting for you to come back and face him! I came especially to bring you back, so nothing happens to you on the road.

Act7-1a#7.zh: 此去野猪林山贼众多，要是林教头出了什么意外，在下可无法跟上司交代...林冲，回东京吧！
Act7-1a#7.t: Wild Boar Forest ahead is full of bandits. If anything happened to you, I couldn't answer to my superiors... Lin Chong, come back to Kaifeng!

Act7-1a#9.zh: 等一下。林冲，你相信他的话？
Act7-1a#9.t: Wait. Lin Chong, you believe him?

Act7-1a#10.zh: 陆谦是我多年的好友，岂有欺骗我的道理？
Act7-1a#10.t: Lu Qian has been my friend for years. Why would he deceive me?

Act7-1a#11.zh: 你又是什么东西！林冲好不容易有辩解自己罪名的机会，你要他放弃这个机会，一辈子当个不忠不孝之人！
Act7-1a#11.t: And who are you? Lin Chong finally has a chance to clear his name, and you want him to throw it away and live as a disloyal, unfilial man forever!

Act7-1a#12.zh: 哼哼...话倒是说得满漂亮的；但是，那些树林中的杀气是什么？！
Act7-1a#12.t: Heh... fine words. But what's that killing intent in the trees?!

Act7-1a#13.t: Hmph... found out. Come on out!

Act7-1a#14.t: Lu Qian! You meant to betray me!

Act7-1a#15.zh: 林冲，我等虽然无仇；但是受人之托，忠人之事。高太尉答应只要我带着你的首级回去，他会给我优厚的奖赏...
Act7-1a#15.t: Lin Chong, there's no grudge between us, but I keep faith with those who hire me. Marshal Gao promised me a rich reward if I bring back your head...

Act7-1a#16.zh: 你这无耻之徒！为了高官厚禄就可以当高俅的爪牙吗！
Act7-1a#16.t: You shameless wretch! You'd be Gao Qiu's lackey for rank and pay?

Act7-1a#17.zh: 哈哈哈...！没错！跟着高太尉荣华富贵享用不尽；你能当我的踏脚石，也算是你的荣幸了！手下，把他们一个都不留地杀光！
Act7-1a#17.t: Hahaha...! That's right! With Marshal Gao there's no end of wealth and glory. Being my stepping stone is an honour for you! Men, kill them all, leave no one alive!
